basis: The published h3_tiling.py of selflift-Avatar v0.1.2-experimental. Its sha256 matches the published_python_sha256 entry for h3_tiling.py in that repository's PROVENANCE.json, confirming the exact file that was ported.
upstream_basis: selflift-Avatar's h3_tiling.py is a snapshot of the upstream file plus a mask-compatibility guard. selflift-Avatar does not record the upstream commit it snapshotted; the checked hash below is the current upstream file at the commit listed.
local_changes: Error message prefix changed from 'selflift-Avatar:' to 'Swan_Bits H3 tiling:'.
Wrapper key changed from 'selflift_high_resolution_tiling' to 'swan_bits_high_resolution_tiling' so both plugins can be installed at once.
Added an optional forced tile count (plan['force_tiles']); 0 keeps the upstream automatic workspace search.
Added the SWAN_H3TiledModel node (MODEL + high-res stage LATENT -> MODEL) and a module docstring.
